harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: On node1 (RHEL 10), built a local RPM repository from local storage (/srv/local-repo, populated via createrepo_c), served it over HTTP on NODE_IP:8080, disabled the remote RHEL CDN repos and blocked cdn.redhat.com via /etc/hosts to simulate the remote repos being unreachable, then installed the `tree` package purely from the local repo. Verified installation success and functionality, restored remote reachability and repo config, then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured boot_id baseline, rebooted node1 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified the installed package, local repo files, and repo configuration all persisted post-restart.
actions_performed: Installed createrepo_c on node1
Downloaded tree-2.1.0-8.el10.x86_64.rpm into /srv/local-repo via dnf download
Ran createrepo_c to generate repodata
Started python3 http.server on port 8080 bound to 0.0.0.0, serving /srv/local-repo
Added /etc/yum.repos.d/local-storage.repo pointing to http://$NODE_IP:8080/
Added a fake /etc/hosts entry redirecting cdn.redhat.com to 127.0.0.1 and disabled the two RHEL CDN repos to make remote repos unreachable
Installed tree package using only the local-storage repo while remote repos were unreachable
Verified tree binary works and cdn.redhat.com remained unreachable during install
Removed the /etc/hosts override and re-enabled the RHEL CDN repos, confirmed connectivity and repolist restored
Captured pre-restart boot_id and health baseline (tree installed, local repo HTTP 200)
Rebooted node1 via 'systemctl reboot' launched through a backgrounded nohup+disown so the ack returned first
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again after connection timeouts
Confirmed boot_id changed post-restart and verified tree package, local repo files, and yum repo configuration all persisted

evidence.requirement: Local package repository served from local storage on node1
evidence.summary: createrepo_c installed, tree rpm downloaded into /srv/local-repo, repodata generated, HTTP server started on NODE_IP:8080 returning 200, and local-storage.repo added pointing at it

evidence.requirement: Remote repositories made unreachable before install
evidence.summary: cdn.redhat.com redirected to loopback in /etc/hosts (curl exit 7 confirms unreachable) and the two RHEL CDN repos disabled, leaving only local-storage enabled in dnf repolist

evidence.requirement: Package installed successfully from the local repo while remote repos unreachable
evidence.summary: dnf install -y tree succeeded using only 'local-storage' repo; tree binary confirmed functional (tree --version) while cdn.redhat.com still returned status 000

evidence.requirement: Restore remote repository access after the disruption
evidence.summary: Removed hosts override, re-enabled both RHEL CDN repos, confirmed TLS handshake succeeds to cdn.redhat.com and dnf repolist/makecache work normally again
Captured boot_id 4ebdfa06-919e-48a9-8a15-475d9007662c, tree package present, and local repo HTTP 200 prior to reboot

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot launched via backgrounded/disowned subshell so the exec call returned 'reboot scheduled' before the node dropped

evidence.requirement: node1 became unreachable then recovered execution availability
evidence.summary: Subsequent polls timed out (connection timed out) during reboot, then a later poll succeeded, proving the node went down and came back

evidence.requirement: node1 boot identity changed, proving an actual restart occurred
evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id is 80f28a15-4bc2-441a-968a-23fcc0536af2 (different from baseline 4ebdfa06...), with new boot time 10:16:03 vs previous 10:14:04

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of installed package and repository data
evidence.summary: tree package still reported installed and functional after reboot; /srv/local-repo repodata files and /etc/yum.repos.d/local-storage.repo config intact, and full dnf repolist (local-storage + both CDN repos) restored

Verified installation success and functionality, restored remote reachability and repo config, then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured boot_id baseline, rebooted node1 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified the installed package, local repo files, and repo configuration all persisted post-restart.
